auth.description: Optional caller credential sent as an HTTP auth header on each delivery, in addition to the HMAC signature. Lets the receiving endpoint authenticate the request. On update, omit `auth` to preserve the existing credential; there is no in-place removal — recreate the trigger to remove auth.
